audit.why: 53.69% over 3215 games, FAV at 6/10 — Olaf owns the lane, Nautilus reclaims value in 5v5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet chart, with the mirror audit, and with the prose beneath them: whys[3] says Olaf's short trades snowball and Nautilus cannot disengage a slowed target, yet the row read Skill; whys[6] says Nautilus out-scales the lane, yet the row read Olaf.
audit.why: Nautilus has no escape from a chained Undertow slow and no way to out-damage true damage in lane; the reversal comes at full tank build in teamfights, not at two items in the side lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Olaf, row 6 to Skill, in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them. Final chart: Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says four times that Ragnarok 'cleanses' Nautilus's chain — 'R cleanses the chain', 'Ragnarok cleanses his hook, passive root and R knockup', 'Hold Ragnarok to cleanse his hook-root-R chain'. Riot's text for Ragnarok is 'become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'. That is immunity held while attacking, not a cleanse, and it is conditional on continuing to swing.
audit.why: The distinction changes the button order. 'Hold Ragnarok to cleanse' teaches the player to get hooked first and ult after — but immunity does not retroactively free him, and if he stops attacking it lapses. The correct instruction is to press R before the engage lands and keep autoing.
audit.corrected: Every cleanse phrasing rewritten to disable immunity held while attacking, with the sequencing reversed to press-before-the-hook. Dredge Line given its 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown and 1150 range, Riptide its 7s and slow, Titan's Wrath its shield-plus-damage-over-time. Undertow named as the 9s armour-shred slow that resets on pickup.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Dredge Line' repeated eight times with no duration.
audit.why: Dredge Line at 14s rank 1 is the longest punishable gap in the lane and is his only engage — a missed hook is a 14-second free window.
audit.corrected: 14s written into the cooldown breakdown, the interactions line and the do's entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cannot verify whether Ragnarok's disable immunity covers Depth Charge's knockup, which is a displacement rather than a standard disable.
audit.why: Riot's ability text does not distinguish displacement from disable, and needsResearch is empty by design. Per the standing rule I did not assert it either way, so the R-knockup claim was removed rather than reversed.
audit.corrected: Depth Charge dropped from the list of things Ragnarok walks through; nothing asserted in its place.

edits.before: This is your lane. Keep him perma-slowed with chained Q pickups and out-sustain his auto-and-E poke with W omnivamp while your short trades snowball. The whole matchup pivots on Ragnarok: when you hit 6, his hook, passive root and R knockup are all CC you can simply ignore, so bait the hook, ult, and run him down or dive him under tower. With Bramble/Black Cleaver coming, you're at your most oppressive — every trade favors you.
edits.after: This is your lane. Keep him perma-slowed with chained Undertow pickups and out-sustain his auto-and-Riptide poke with Vicious Strikes while your short trades snowball. The whole matchup pivots on Ragnarok: press it before Dredge Line lands, not after, because it is disable immunity for as long as you keep attacking — bait the hook, ult, and run him down or dive him under tower. With Bramble/Black Cleaver coming, you're at your most oppressive.

edits.after: Bait Ragnarok out with a hook, then chain his CC back the moment it expires on you

notes: The recurring error was calling Ragnarok a cleanse. Riot's text is 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking' — immunity conditional on continuing to swing, not a removal of CC already on you. The page's old sequencing (get hooked, then ult) is the wrong button order and has been reversed everywhere. I also removed the specific claim that Ragnarok walks through Depth Charge's knockup: displacement versus disable is not distinguishable from Riot's text and needsResearch is empty by design, so per the standing rule nothing was asserted either way — see unverified. KIT FLAG MISFIRE, same as the mirror: olaf.json tags Undertow with grounding, but Riot's description is damage plus Armor and Move Speed reduction only, so no grounding claim was written.
